title: Dictionaries and Maps
summary: Dictionaries (hash maps) store key-value pairs: look up a value instantly by its key instead of scanning a list.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Dictionaries (hash maps) store key-value pairs: look up a value instantly by its key instead of scanning a list.
Think of a real dictionary: word -> definition. In code: username -> user object, or product id -> price. Keys must be unique.
Key points: average lookup is extremely fast, keys are often strings or numbers, and missing keys need safe handling (.get / has checks).
Summary: Dictionaries and Maps — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
